contentList.content: You are maintaining Focus on a spell. Immune to damage interruption while unburdened; does not conflict with active Concentration.
Voluntarily release your active Focus, freeing your mind.
Through martial training, you can make melee and ranged weapon attacks, utilize Extra Attack, and execute weapon actions while Concentrating without breaking your concentration.
Concentration Disruption: Casting this spell requires complete magical focus and will immediately shatter active Concentration.
